_doc: Unlearn: what could stop it within a year of no input, and the safeguard for each. Every probe is checked by tests/foundation/test_unlearn.py (file and grep probes must hold; test probes name a test that exists). Platform-wide faults (Actions outages, GitHub and Cloudflare incidents, Node end of life) are covered by doctrine/yearsim.json and apply to this Worker too.

risks.what: Workers AI retires the model that re-words moves (happened 2026-11-20 to the platform)
risks.safeguard: moves come from the library with no model; models are read from doctrine/models.json fallback_order (refreshed by modelwatch), each failure falls through to the next and then to the library text
risks.probe: test:a model re-wording that explains is refused and the library text is kept; a retired model falls through to the next

risks.what: model calls grow with traffic past the budget
risks.safeguard: AI_DAILY_CAP (default 200 calls a day) and the library fallback; the account-wide spend governor (seed/worker/src/spend.js) still applies
risks.probe: test:the AI daily cap holds and the app keeps answering from the library

risks.what: one source floods writes and fills D1
risks.safeguard: 30 writes per source per day by a daily one-way hash; inputs capped at 280 and 1000 characters
risks.probe: test:writes per source per day are capped with a plain message

risks.what: D1 grows without bound over a year
risks.safeguard: hourly retention: text older than 400 days removed, counters kept 30 days, beats 90 days
risks.probe: test:retention removes old text and keeps the counts; health reports a stopped clock

risks.what: the Cloudflare cron stops firing or is dropped on a redeploy
risks.safeguard: a visit runs the beat when the last one is over 2 hours old; the unlearn-beat clock in doctrine/clocks.json is read by the watchdog from D1 and a stopped clock is a defect
risks.probe: test:a silent cron is caught up by the next visit (second route for the clock)

risks.safeguard: the Worker holds no secret; deploys use the GitHub OIDC token minted per run (deploy-ultrastable.yml), so nothing expires

risks.what: an npm package breaks or is withdrawn
risks.safeguard: zero dependencies: plain Worker modules, a pinned compatibility_date, node:sqlite only in tests
two routes: deploy-ultrastable.yml through the site deployer, and deploy/deploy-workers.mjs with wrangler; both read doctrine/topology.json

risks.what: a move explains the answer and turns coaching back into teaching
risks.safeguard: the answer guard checks every library move in tests and every model re-wording at runtime
risks.probe: test:no library move explains an answer, and every kind and age band is covered

risks.what: phase 1 never meets its gates, so nothing moves on
risks.safeguard: gates are measured every hour and published at /api/metrics with value and sample; phase 2 opens by itself the hour they hold
risks.probe: test:phase 2 opens by itself when the phase 1 gates hold, and its school-group UI lights

risks.what: children's personal data enters before the law allows
risks.safeguard: phase 3 cannot open on metrics alone; it needs every prerequisite in phases.json and the controller-entity gate
risks.probe: test:phase 3 never opens on metrics alone: it needs its privacy prerequisites

risks.safeguard: HALT stops the cron and new writes; reads keep serving
risks.probe: test:HALT stops the cron and new writes; reads keep serving

owner_only.what: a legal entity that is data controller for direct child accounts (phase 3)
owner_only.default_in_effect: phase 3 stays closed; phases 1 and 2 run
